claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
A low, distant room tone and a faint rumble build in the darkness before the car appears.
The car's tyres roll slowly and its engine hums as it advances into the light.

subjects.description: A car moving forward out of darkness.

summary.text: A car pulls forward out of darkness into a faint band of light.

description.text: A wide expanse of deep darkness fills the frame, its black mass broken only by a faint low sheen of reflected light near the bottom edge. Nothing in the frame moves yet; the shadow seems to deepen and settle, resolving from an unreadable void into a textured, faintly lit space.
Deep blackness occupies the image, with a faint low sheen near the lower edge.
A low, distant room tone sits under the silence.
A faint rumble builds beneath the stillness.

noses out of the blackness and rolls steadily forward toward the viewer. Its dark body catches a growing band of light as it clears the shadow, and its headlights brighten the ground ahead before it eases to a halt nearer the foreground. The surrounding darkness recedes just enough to make the vehicle clearly readable.
emerges from the shadow and rolls forward toward the viewer.
Tyres roll slowly over a hard surface.
The hum of an idling engine rises as the car advances.

soundscape: Low, distant room tone and a faint rumble give way to slow tyres and a rising engine hum as the car moves forward out of the darkness.
